observations.record_label: NOTICE OF REOPENING OF PUBLIC COMMENT PERIOD ON PROPOSED RULES
The board of correction shall take all actions necessary for implementation of the local law, including promulgation of rules.
Issue a public report on conditions at any correctional facility opened after the effective date of the local law before the department of correction houses incarcerated individuals there.

Issue a report on issues related to the Department of Correction’s grievance process, incorporating direct feedback from incarcerated individuals, proposed recommendations for relevant improvements, and recommendations on improving the grievance process for vulnerable populations, including incarcerated individuals who are lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, and gender nonconforming; submit the report to the Council and post it on the Board’s website.
Take all actions necessary to implement the local law, including promulgating rules concerning procedures and penalties.

Establish procedures for the hearing of grievances, complaints or requests for assistance by or on behalf of persons held or confined under the Department of Correction’s jurisdiction or by Department employees.
Submit to the council a report on the impact on incarcerated individuals of closing jails on Rikers Island and constructing new facilities to replace such jails.
Publish a preliminary report on its website after allowing time for public notification and no later than 10 days after the death.

Include specified information in each preliminary report, including the deceased individual’s identifying information, death location, facility and housing history, health information, grievances, and referrals.
